title: Aye gul-e-narjis biya biya
body:
Aye gul-e-narjis biya biya
<<DIVIDER>>
Al-ajal ya imaam..(4)
Al-ajal, al-ajal ya imam-e-zamaan
Al-ajal, al-ajal ya imam-e-zamaan al-ajal..(2)
As-salam-o-alaika ya sahib-az-zamaa..
Tera hai intezaar aaja, ya imaam
Zehra ke pursadaar aaja, ya imaam
Waris-e-zulfiqaar aaja, ya imaam
Al-ajal ya imam
Aajaiye bus aap ka hi intezaar hai, intezaar hai
Is daur ka ilaaj faqad zulfiqaar hai, zulfiqaar hai
<<MINI>>
Behre inteqam-e-pehlu-e-zehra..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Behre inteqam-e-khoon-e-husain
<<MINI>>
Aye gul-e-narjis biya biya..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Aisa ho ek ashura, kaabe me majlis ho barpa
Tu mimbar pe jalwa numa, tu padhe majlis hum nauha
Tere bina ho kese khwaab ye pura
Kabe se nikle juloos-e-ashura
<<MINI>>
Ae ibn-e-sarallah, jaan-e shere khuda, waris-ul-aimmah, ae hujjat-e-khuda
Behre inteqam-e-pehlu-e-zehra..(2)
Behre inteqam-e-khoon-e-husain, hussain hussain hussain
Aye gul-e-narjis biya biya..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
Tu hai farzand-e-zehra todke sadiyo ka pehra
Tu hi jiska waris hai kabe tu wo alam lehra
Hum hi nahi hai azadaar hai tub hi
Tera alam hai alamdaar hai tub hi
<<MINI>>
Ae ibn-e-sarallah, jaan-e shere khuda, waris-ul-aimmah, ae hujjat-e-khuda

Behre inteqam-e-khoon-e-hussain, hussain hussain hussain

<<DIVIDER>>
Saath tere ye ehl-e-aza jaaye shaam aur karbobala
Qabr-e-shahedeen par jaakar de tujhe tere jadd kar pursa
Aisa banaye waha matami halqa
Jis me ali bhi ho, hasan bhi aur Mustafa
<<MINI>>
Ae ibn-e-sarallah, jaan-e shere khuda, waris-ul-aimmah, ae hujjat-e-khuda

<<DIVIDER>>
Qaatilan-e-sheh ko mita de, saara jahaa milkar ye sadaa de
<<MINI>>
Sayyad-us-shohada, hussain hussain
Mazloom-e-karbala, hussain hussain
Waris-ul-ambiya, hussain hussain
Ae ibn-e-sayyada, hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Saare zamane me yahi gunje ek naara, hussain hussain
<<MINI>>
Aye gul-e-narjis biya biya..(6)
<<DIVIDER>>
Aap hi qaaed ho hamare, farsh-e-aza pe har dil ye pukare
<<MINI>>
Sayyad-us-shohada, hussain hussain
Mazloom-e-karbala, hussain hussain
Waris-ul-ambiya, hussain hussain
Ae ibn-e-sayyada, hussain hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Masjid me bhi, mandir me bhi , gunje ek naara, hussain hussain
<<MINI>>
Aye gul-e-narjis biya biya..(6)
<<DIVIDER>>
Ye jahaa bhool na jae kahi karbobala, al madad ya imam-e-zamaa
Ja bajaa dekhe nigaahe yuhi farsh-e-aza, al-madad ya imam-e-zamaa
Kaun hai waris-e- farsh-e-aza maula
<<MINI>>
Kise bulae tere siwaa..(2)
Aye gul-e-narjis biya biya..(6)
<<DIVIDER>>
Marqad-e-khair-un-nisa pet u roza bana, al madad ya imam-e-zamaa
Zulm ki zadd pe hai roza bibi zainab ka, al madad ya imam-e-zamaa
Jab likha tujhko ariza yahi baat likhi
<<MINI>>
Kise bulae tere siwaa..(2)
Aye gul-e-narjis biya biya..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Haay..
Manzar ye padhke aaj bhi hote hai dil figaar
Baithe hue hai aap musalle pe ashkbaar
Deodi pe zuljanaah ho alam bhi hai sogwaar
<<DIVIDER>>
Pehlu me zulfiqaar hai chalne ko beqaraar, chalne ko beqaraar
Wirde zabaa hai ziyarat-e-naahiya baar baar
Haay..
Ho salaam unpe ke jin laasho ko paamaal kiya
<<DIVIDER>>
Ho salaam uspe dame qatl jo pyaasa hi raha
Ho salaam uspe ke paikar se chhida jiska gala
Ho salaam uspe jo tukdo me bata wa waila
Jiska laasha mehroom-e-kafan uspe salaam
<<DIVIDER>>
Jiska loota gaya ek din me chaman uspe salaam
<<MINI>>
Hussain maula hussain maula..(3)
<<DIVIDER>>
Haay..
Jiske seene me hai barchi ki ani usko salaam
Jo tha hamshakl-e-rasool-e-madani usko salaam
Aag jis bibi ke daaman me lagi usko salaam
<<DIVIDER>>
Nauke naiza se rida jiski chini usko salaam
Jinke baazu hue paband-e-rasan unpe salaam
Jinke zakhmi hue durro se badan unpe salaam
<<MINI>>
Hussain maula hussain maula..(3)
<<DIVIDER>>
Sad alwida hussaina, hussain hussain hussaina
Ya hasrata hussaina, hussain hussain hussaina
Wa ghurbata hussaina, hussain hussain hussaina
Ae bekhata hussaina, hussain hussain hussaina
Bus taziyana harjaa, , hussain hussain hussaina
Haay Pehlu-e-bint-e-zehra, hussain hussain hussaina
<<MINI>>
Hussain maula hussain maula hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
Bekas, Ghareeb, Shaheed, pyasa.
Hussain hussain hussain..
